messages:
IncidentBot: alert — rollout 'staged-release-2026-03' in eu-west-1 has SLI deviation: 5xx rate +6.3% over baseline. Rolling canary groups: alpha,beta. @Mira oncall paging.

Alex: seeing increased 502s from tokenizer service on canary-alpha. logs: `tokenizer: unexpected EOF` — suspect new tokenizer model.

Mira: I'm oncall, grabbing. @Sam can you confirm feature flag state for `use-new-tokenizer`?

Sam: flag is at 25% (canary-alpha). I can flip to 0% now.

Mira: holding automated rollback for 60s, starting targeted drain for canary-alpha. Running:
```
redwood ctl drain --group canary-alpha --grace 90s
```

DeployBot: automated rollback policy 'rapid-degrade' queued but not executed (manual-inhibit by oncall).

Alex: traffic to alpha dropping. error rate starting to fall but tail latency still high.

Sam: flipping flag now -> `/ff set use-new-tokenizer 0 --scope canary-alpha` :white_check_mark: 

DeployBot: flag change propagated to edge in 12s.

Nora: we should verify model variant pinned on route; if flag flip doesn't help, we'll do manual rollback to model:v1.11.

Mira: flag flip helped — errors down to baseline (~0.4%). However CPU on tok-service still +30%. Starting manual rollback to model:v1.11 for canary-alpha:
```
redwood deploy rollback --target model:v1.11 --route canary-alpha --batch 25% --interval 30s
```

IncidentBot: Customer impact assessment: ~14 customer sessions affected (estimated), writes retried, no data loss. Severity P2. Paging external SRE team as precaution.

Pager: acknowledged. Oncall rotation: @Nora will handle post-rollback monitoring.

DeployBot: rollback in progress: 25% -> 50% at step 2.

Alex: running smoke tests:
`curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | jq .status`

Sam: smoke ok, responses good, latency ok.

DeployBot: rollback reached 100% at 5112233670. model:v1.11 active on canary-alpha and promoted.

Mira: verifying key SLOs for 10 minutes, will hold open for 30m then close.

Alex: marking this thread for follow-up postmortem and postdeploy sanity check added to runbook. :memo: 

Mira: adding action: add preflight model healthcheck that checks tokenizer EOF errors before rollout.

IncidentBot: Incident marked RESOLVED (P2) at 5112233678. Closing thread.
